subject: Brightlane — co-author onboarding slate & MAP seed
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Brightlane — co-author onboarding slate & MAP seed

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion I put together a compact onboarding slate (MAP seed) that captures the evaluation milestones, stakeholder owners, and a proposed 30-day pilot close timeline. The draft is intentionally short so your team can co-author and iterate quickly.

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm the primary stakeholders to be owners for the sections below (Tech validation, Security review, Procurement, Product acceptance)
- Add any hard dates/blackout windows for October–November
- Accept or edit the proposed week0 workshop agenda so we can lock a time

I created a working GDoc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/BRIGHTLANE-MAP-SEED-1 (edit access — please co-author).

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_map_seed_v1.gdoc (MAP seed — compact)

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0: kickoff + technical smoke test (1–2 days)
- Week 1–2: integration & performance validation (inc. small-scale inference tests)
- Week 3: acceptance checks and go/no-go decision
- Week 4: close/next steps (pilot kickoff or roll-out)

If that looks good I’ll add your stakeholders into the doc and loop in Procurement and Security for the short questionnaires. Open to shifting cadence — tell me what works for you.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@brightlane.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Derek Huang <derek.huang@brightlane.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightlane — co-author onboarding slate & MAP seed

Rachel — thanks for the note and for getting the doc started. Important folks on our side:
- Sarah Lee — Head of ML (primary stakeholder)
- Derek Huang — Platform Eng (tech lead)
- Priya Rao — Security (security reviewer)
- Ben Carter (Procurement contact will be procurement@brightlane.com)

I've added Derek and Priya to the GDoc and dropped a few comments under the "integration" section about our current infra constraints (we're on k8s with node autoscaling turned off until end of month). Procurement wants an initial MSA/statement of work sketch before they commit time — they'd prefer a short procurement checklist rather than a full redline at this stage.

Workshop: Wed 14 Oct 10:30–11:00 PT or Thu 15 Oct 14:00–14:30 PT would work for Derek and me. Can you share an agenda and a slide that shows the week0 checklist?

Thanks —
Sarah
Head of ML, Brightlane

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Brightlane — co-author onboarding slate & MAP seed

Thanks Sarah — added Derek and Priya into the doc and created a small procurement checklist under the "Procurement" section (short items: pricing summary, SOW sketch, data residency note). Procurement email included here so they can confirm the checklist format.

Workshop — both times work for us; can we lock Wed 14 Oct 10:30–11:00 PT? I’ve attached a compact slide deck for Week 0 that outlines the kickoff agenda and the quick validation checklist.

Attachments (stubs):
- week0-workshop-slides.pptx

Quick agenda (30 min):
- 5 min — intros & goals
- 10 min — infra & integration approach (Derek + Ben)
- 10 min — validation criteria and acceptance gates
- 5 min — next steps & mutual owners

I’ll move the acceptance dates into the GDoc once we confirm your internal availability. If Procurement prefers a DocuSign or a short MSA draft, Ben can share a one-page SOW sketch before the meeting.

Best —
Rachel
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Rachel / team —

Quick tech note: I uploaded a short infra readiness checklist for Derek to scan before Wed. It covers GPU access, network egress rules, and a small sample dataset for smoke testing. Happy to own the tech portion of the kickoff.

Attachments (stub):
- infra-readiness-checklist.xlsx

I’ll join the 10:30 PT slot and will be prepared to walk the integration steps.

Cheers —
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
